name: Mastery: Draining Bane
description: When an adversary attacks you or an ally within Very Close range, you can spend 2 Favor to temporarily Drain them. When you do, they must mark a Stress and you can clear a Stress. A Drained creature uses a d12 instead of a d20 for attack rolls.
